mapper.sql: SELECT s.id, s.athlete_id, s.dept_id, s.snapshot_date, s.risk_score, s.todo_priority, s.process_only, s.process_flags, s.suggested_level, s.factors, s.status, s.handled_by, s.handled_time, s.handle_remark, s.accepted_status, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_time, a.name AS athlete_name, d.dept_name AS athlete_team, a.gender AS athlete_gender, CASE WHEN a.birthday IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, a.birthday, CURDATE()) END AS athlete_age FROM apms_rtp_risk_snapshot s LEFT JOIN apms_athlete a ON s.athlete_id = a.athlete_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON a.primary_team_id = d.dept_id
mapper.select: SELECT id, athlete_id, dept_id, snapshot_date, risk_score, todo_priority, process_only, process_flags, suggested_level, factors, status, handled_by, handled_time, handle_remark, accepted_status, create_by, create_time, update_time FROM apms_rtp_risk_snapshot WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
WHERE s.athlete_id = #{athleteId} AND s.status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.suggested_level != 'NONE' ORDER BY s.snapshot_date DESC, s.id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO apms_rtp_risk_snapshot ( athlete_id, dept_id, snapshot_date, risk_score, todo_priority, process_only, process_flags, suggested_level, factors, status, create_by, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{athleteId}, #{deptId}, #{snapshotDate}, #{riskScore}, #{todoPriority}, #{processOnly}, #{processFlags}, #{suggestedLevel}, #{factors}, 'ACTIVE', #{createBy}, sysdate(), sysdate() )
mapper.update: UPDATE apms_rtp_risk_snapshot SET risk_score = #{riskScore}, todo_priority = #{todoPriority}, process_only = #{processOnly}, process_flags = #{processFlags}, suggested_level = #{suggestedLevel}, factors = #{factors}, dept_id = #{deptId}, update_time = sysdate() WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE apms_rtp_risk_snapshot SET status = 'EXPIRED', update_time = sysdate() WHERE snapshot_date < #{snapshotDate} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
